summary: Teamshares Inc filed this 8-K to report completion of its business combination with Live Oak Acquisition Corp. V, a SPAC. Legacy Teamshares merged with SPAC subsidiaries, becoming the surviving public company, renamed Teamshares Inc. The filing notes the Merger Agreement was signed Nov 14, 2025, amended twice, and closed June 18, 2026. It references the Proxy Statement/Prospectus for terms but does not disclose price, premium, or specific deal mechanics here. The registrant was the target entity; this is a de-SPAC going-private transaction. What to watch: post-merger stock and warrant trading under new symbols TMS and TMSWW.
